summary:
Iter139 — WKQ Arcane Hearth 3D v1 (game_id=wkq-arcane-hearth-3d-v1) 3-level pass. BACKEND: 8/8 pytest GREEN in /app/backend/tests/test_iter139_wkq_arcane_v1.py (junit /app/test_reports/pytest/iter139.xml). Coverage: (1) GET /api/realm-keys/registry?game_id=wkq-arcane-hearth-3d-v1 returns exactly 3 active keys with level_index=[0,1,2] AND level_no=[1,3,5] (matches seed_wkq_arcane_v2.py L1/L3/L5 mapping). (2) POST /api/realm-keys/award idempotent for each level_index 0/1/2 on a fresh throwaway user (first call awarded:true, second call already_owned:true). (3) POST /api/realm-keys/award {level_index:9} returns 404. (4) GET /api/games/wkq-arcane-hearth-3d-v1/fire-info as founder returns enabled:true, rewards.completion=50, rewards.final_completion=250 — exact founder-mandated economy (+50 FP per level, +250 finale). (5) POST /api/games/wkq-arcane-hearth-3d-v1/score idempotency: with founder+wipe of prior gfp:* transactions and game_progress reset: first call {stage_reached:1, completed:false, game_version:2} granted ('Stage 1 cleared', 50); repeat call granted 0 stage-1 (idempotent gfp:stage:{game_id}:{uid}:1). Then {stage_reached:3, completed:true, game_version:2} granted Stage 2 +50, Stage 3 +50, Game completed +250 (server-verified milestones). Repeat call returned fire_rewards=[] (finale + stage grants all idempotent via credit_fire idempotency_key). Cleanup wipes founder gfp:* fire_wallet_transactions and refunds fire_economy.pool at test end.

FRONTEND E2E (stealth founder, /games?play=wkq-arcane-hearth-3d-v1): (a) [data-testid=three-runtime] + [data-testid=three-canvas-mount] mount; WebGL renderer live. (b) HUD reads exactly 'Level 1/3 · 🥕 0/3 · 🪙 0 · 💎 0 · ⭐ 0' — matches spec. Quest msg 'Sky Harbor Kitchens — speak with the chef!' — matches L1 title. (c) Ground+walls TEXTURED, not flat grey (screenshot .screenshots/arcane_L1_start.png shows cobblestone flagstone floor + tiled masonry walls). Sky is bright blue (#7fc4e8) — matches L1 spec. (d) window.__OR3D_TEXDBG populated with 2 texture URLs both status 'loaded' (arc_ground_l1 + arc_wall_l1 media images). window.__OR3D_ASSETS lists all 6 slots (arc_ground_l1/l3/l5 + arc_wall_l1/l3/l5). window.__OR3D live-state polls {x,z,level,phase,ing,coins,gems,stars,orbs,won,cam} — verified moves as player position changes. (e) Fire-info banner reads '🔥 Fire Power rewards — server-verified · Stage clear +50 · Finish +250 (once per player)' — exact match. (f) Fullscreen toggle [data-testid=three-fullscreen-toggle] adds document.body.className 'or3d-css-fs' and CSS FS layer (position:fixed inset:0 z:100); toggling again removes the class — verified both directions. (g) No uncaught JS console errors; only pre-existing 401s on unrelated anon endpoints. (h) REGRESSION: /games?play=wkq-skybound-chef-v2 loads iframe title screen 'World Kitchen Quest: Skybound Chef' with 'TAP OR PRESS ANY KEY TO START' and fire-info banner '🔥 Fire Power rewards — server-verified · Finish +10,000 (once per player)' — iter138 build intact.

NOT PROVEN in playwright (documented limitation only, NOT a product bug): full L1 quest loop end-to-end. Cause: L1 wall [-14, 4, 8, 2] (center x=-14, z=4, w=8, d=2) creates a barrier along z≈2.5–5.5 spanning x=[-18.5, -9.5]. Player spawn (-17, 13) travelling straight-'w' hits the wall at z≈5.65 and is correctly stopped by axis-separated collision (Math.abs(pz-4)<1.5). Required path is east FIRST (past x=-9.5) then south to NPC(-16,-10) — a two-segment detour that Playwright's dispatched keyboard events couldn't chain reliably within reasonable timeouts. All quest-loop primitives (phase 'talk'->NPC->'gather'->pickups->station->'fight'->guardian->'key'->portal->award) are individually implemented and reviewed in ThreeRuntime.jsx lines 185-241, and backend award+score idempotency is fully proven via pytest.

issues: Spawn (-17,13) is on the 'wrong' side of wall [-14,4,8,2] relative to the NPC at (-16,-10); a straight w-hold stops at z≈5.5 due to that wall. Not a bug — collision is correct — but the level requires an east-detour past x=-9.5 to reach the chef. Suggest making L1 more forgiving for the intro level (e.g., shift the wall or the spawn) so first-time players intuit the path, and/or add an on-screen hint arrow to the NPC when phase='talk'.

action_items: OPTIONAL (nice-to-have, not blocking): expose a debug hook window.__OR3D_TP(x,z) to teleport the player for automated regression, OR add a small 'Talk to Chef' waypoint arrow when phase==='talk'. Enables full-loop E2E automation in future iterations.
OPTIONAL: consider softening L1 layout (spawn or wall) so a naive 'walk toward NPC' path succeeds without a detour — Level 1 is the tutorial level.
Not required: greybox character primitives are FOUNDER-APPROVED interim art until Meshy GLB pass — do NOT flag.
critical_code_review_comments: realm_keys.py award() correctly reads the registry server-side (browser cannot supply key_id/series/amount); idempotency via {user_id,key_id} $setOnInsert upsert; 404 on unknown level; 400 on non-integer level_index; MongoDB _id excluded via {_id:0}. CLEAN.

games_plus.py /fire-info returns {enabled:true, rewards.completion:50, rewards.final_completion:250} for wkq-arcane-hearth-3d-v1 exactly per founder directive; pool_remaining exposed but no legacy 'X Fire available' pool banner.

games_plus.py submit_score() grants 'Stage {i} cleared' for every stage index 1..min(stage_reached, n_stages), all via idempotent gfp:stage:{game_id}:{uid}:{i} keys through credit_fire idempotency_key — proven non-replayable in test_score_stage_and_finale_idempotent. 'Game completed' also idempotent via gfp:final:{game_id}:{uid}.

seed_wkq_arcane_v2.py registry seeding uses level_index=0/1/2 (active array mapping) with level_no=1/3/5 (original numbering preserved) — deliberate to keep frontend loadQuestLevel(i) simple while surfaces L1/L3/L5 titling. WIP L2/L4 preserved in spec.wip_levels_3d as documented.

ThreeRuntime.jsx submitScore + awardRealmKey (~lines 91-99, 232-240) fire the correct endpoints with level_index=lvIdx (active-array index 0/1/2) matching the registry. Portal-touch triggers award ALWAYS and then either final submit (last level) or per-stage stage_reached+1 submit — correct.
ThreeRuntime.jsx fullscreen toggle applies CSS class 'or3d-css-fs' to body AND attempts native requestFullscreen — dual approach ensures the 3D player fills viewport even when native FS is blocked.
questLevel.js texture loader instruments window.__OR3D_TEXDBG[url] = loading|loaded|error:{reason} — excellent debug surface, confirmed 'loaded' for both L1 textures during play.

success_rate.backend: 100% (8/8 pytest: registry x1, award idempotent x3 levels + invalid 404 + mine, fire-info economy 50/250, stage+finale idempotent, cleanup)
success_rate.frontend: 100% on all directly-testable items (3D canvas + textured L1 rendering, HUD 'Level 1/3', quest label, TEXDBG loaded, __OR3D live state, fire-info banner exact text, fullscreen body class, Skybound regression). Full L1 quest loop not proven end-to-end due to wall-detour navigation friction (documented above, not a bug).

test_credentials: founder stealth / Password1$ (worked). Throwaway 'arc<hex>' auto-registered per pytest run with name+terms+age flags.
seed_data_creation: One throwaway user 'arc<hex>' per pytest run owns 3 db.user_realm_keys rows; test_zzz_cleanup wipes them. Founder gfp:* fire_wallet_transactions for GAME_ID are wiped and fire_economy.pool refunded before + after finale test — no permanent side-effects on stealth account.
context_for_next_testing_agent: wkq-arcane-hearth-3d-v1 is the 3-level 3D quest game (Sky Harbor Kitchens L1 / Copper Stormworks L3 / Festival Citadel L5 with L2/L4 preserved as spec.wip_levels_3d). Backend covered by /app/backend/tests/test_iter139_wkq_arcane_v1.py. Frontend hooks: window.__OR3D (live {x,z,level,phase,ing,coins,gems,stars,orbs,won,cam}), window.__OR3D_TEXDBG (url->status), window.__OR3D_ASSETS (slot names). Fullscreen: body.className contains 'or3d-css-fs' when active. Phases in code: talk->gather->fight->key->portal->done (task called them talk/collect/cook/guardian — same concept). To manually verify L1 loop: from spawn (-17,13) move EAST past x=-9.5 first (to clear the wall [-14,4,8,2]), THEN south to NPC (-16,-10). Collision is axis-separated so straight w-hold hits the wall barrier and stops. Coordinates ground truth: /app/backend/scripts/seed_wkq_arcane_v2.py.
rca of the issue: N/A — no product bugs found. The one E2E-automation gap (full L1 loop) is a Playwright keyboard-navigation limitation against L1's intentional wall geometry, not a game defect. Backend contracts (registry x3 active with level_no 1/3/5, award idempotency per level, fire-info economy 50/250, stage+finale grant idempotency) are all proven server-side; frontend renders textured 3D world, populates __OR3D/__OR3D_TEXDBG debug surfaces, HUD exact-matches spec, and fullscreen toggle applies+removes body class correctly.
